newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt General expected to issue debt.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt General expected to issue debt.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc is expected to tap the corporate bond primary market with a $500 million three-part debt offering, dealers said on Tuesday.
The deal, which is expected to include 10-year, 30-year and 100-year tranches, will be underwritten by Salomon Brothers Inc, dealers said.

On July 2, the publishing company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $550 million in debt securities, bringing the total to $750 million, when combined with previous registrations.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include capital expenditures, working capital requirements and reducing outstanding debt, the firm said.
